_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with NVIDIA's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (NVDA listed 1999-01-22)

pit_profile.why: 'Starting with a focus on PC graphics, NVIDIA invented the graphics processing unit, or GPU, to solve some of the most complex problems in computer science. We have extended our focus in recent years to the revolutionary field of artificial intelligence, or AI.' 'The market for our products is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change and evolving industry standards.' Its current competitors include 'suppliers or licensors of discrete and integrated GPUs and accelerated computing solutions, including chipsets that incorporate 3D graphics, or HPC or accelerated computing functionality as part of their solutions or platforms, such as Advanced Micro Devices, or AMD, Intel Corporation, or Intel, and Xilinx, Inc.' (FY2019 10-K); CYCLICAL kept although the 10-K no longer calls the business cyclical (the BKR FY2015 rule; the class label only); the 10-K names AI as a field NVIDIA has extended its focus to, a market it serves rather than a substitute for its products, so no theme in taxonomy_eras.json applies (the FY2013 10-K's cloud reading), and GPUs integrated into other processors stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -17.8%/yr (worst year FY11-FY19, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -10.3%/yr (Q3 FY20 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.7-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +40.8%/yr (FY11-FY19 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +111.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY19, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NVDA (retrospective, 2019-10-25) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.80x (68.0% downside to Bear $65.41 / +85.0% upside to Bull $378.43) | Adj composite 1.21 vs market 2.31: gap -1.10 [OVERVALUED] | +106% above the EPP floor $99.45 (15x FY20E $6.63) | Conservative 2-yr case: -31.3% total (-15.6%/yr) | At 30.9x FY20E the 15% hurdle price $270.50 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue -17.4% YoY in Q2 FY20, forward revenues -10.7% to -7% (Q3 FY20 revenue guide (Q2 FY20 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
